2608.30581.title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle
2608.30581.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural language queries about a policy's behavior, lack the structure needed for systematic test case generation. We address both. Probabilistic model checking provides the test oracle, computing exact reference results against which LLM answers are graded automatically. A taxonomy of post hoc query categories structures the input space around the environment-level facts from which policy explanations are composed; test cases generated from it are prioritized by question-specific diagnostic difficulty scores. Across seven MDP environments, the testing separates three open-weight LLMs: a reasoning model passes 85% of test cases, a mid-size model 70%, and a 1B model falls below the random baseline, while prioritization surfaces significantly harder cases than random selection. Our results indicate how trustworthy LLM-generated explanations are in model-free settings, where the same LLMs are used but no oracle exists to verify them.
2608.30581.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）被用作序列決策政策的事後解釋，生成自然語言的解釋來說明為何選擇某個行動。<lb/>然而，LLMs 經常生成看似合理但不正確的陳述，且目前沒有現有的方法系統性地測試這些解釋是否忠實於基礎環境。<lb/>兩個經典的軟體測試挑戰阻礙了這一進程：對於解釋的正確性沒有預言者，且測試輸入，即關於政策行為的自然語言查詢，缺乏系統性測試案例生成所需的結構。<lb/>我們解決了這兩個問題。<lb/>概率模型檢查提供了測試預言者，自動計算與 LLM 答案進行評分的準確參考結果。<lb/>事後查詢類別的分類法圍繞著政策解釋所組成的環境層級事實結構化輸入空間；從中生成的測試案例根據問題特定的診斷難度分數進行優先排序。<lb/>在七個 MDP 環境中，測試將三個開放權重的 LLM 分開：一個推理模型通過了 85% 的測試案例，一個中型模型通過了 70%，而一個 1B 模型則低於隨機基準，且優先排序顯示出比隨機選擇更難的案例。<lb/>我們的結果表明，在無模型的設置中，LLM 生成的解釋的可信度如何，這些設置中使用了相同的 LLM，但不存在驗證它們的預言者。
2608.30581.author: Dennis Gross et.al.
